description: Full design record for the Corne.

card.summary: Left half PCB of the Corne, 3x6+3, MX hotswap, Pro Micro footprint.
Wired USB keyboard controller, Pro Micro form factor.
1.5 mm FR4 plate for the Corne left half.
Uniform profile 1u keycap, MX cross stem.
0.91 in monochrome OLED on a 4 pin I2C header.
3.5 mm TRRS jack for the wired link between halves.
